sections.description: Increase your affiliate link clicks and conversions by showing eye-catching highlighter notes on links as visitors scroll through your blog content. Full Lifetime Pro edition featuring unlimited highlighters, custom colors, and scroll-triggered Focus Mode blur.
sections.changelog:
Changelog

  • Initial Lifetime Pro release.
  • Unlocked unlimited highlighter creation and element attachment.
  • Focus Mode background blur support.
  • Custom hex and RGB color pickers enabled.
  • Integrated one-click dashboard updates without license keys.
